facts.fact: Aujourd'hui le Maroc, citing the Ministry of the Interior, reports that the civil-status management system SGEC handles birth declarations and death declarations digitally, with marginal mentions, mentions of marriages and divorces, registers and family booklets, and that over 1,300,000 acts had been declared or issued from it to date.
facts.system: Système de gestion de l'état civil (SGEC)

facts.fact: Aujourd'hui le Maroc, citing the Ministry of the Interior, reports that SGEC is generalised to all the civil-status offices of the Kingdom; the article gives no count of offices, so the share is the ministry's word 'all' with no numerator or denominator.
facts.system: Système de gestion de l'état civil (SGEC)

facts.fact: Aujourd'hui le Maroc, citing the Ministry of the Interior, reports that in SGEC an entry agent at the civil-status office enters acts, the civil-status officer checks and validates them, and the provincial inspector and central inspector consult the acts through the same system; the programme's infrastructure component is a central platform hosting the electronic database with offices permanently connected over a dedicated network, which the article states as what the component is to provide.
facts.system: Système de gestion de l'état civil (SGEC)

facts.fact: Aujourd'hui le Maroc reports that the Ministry of the Interior runs SGEC and the civil-status portal under its civil-status modernisation programme (PMEC).
facts.system: Système de gestion de l'état civil (SGEC)

facts.fact: Aujourd'hui le Maroc reports that the Ministry of the Interior is pursuing its civil-status modernisation programme (PMEC), which names SGEC among its components with the technology infrastructure, the back-capture, the legal overhaul and new citizen services, towards a national civil-status register; no budget or end date is given.
facts.system: Système de gestion de l'état civil (SGEC)
